result.stdout:
Usage: [arguments...] [options...] [-h|--help] [--version]

Recursively cleans bin/obj and optionally node, Cargo, Go, Yarn, pip, uv, publish, artifacts, Visual Studio .vs caches, and NuGet caches.

Arguments:
  [0] <string?>    Optional directory to start the clean. Defaults to current directory.

Options:
  --dry-run      List directories but don't actually delete them.
  --node         Opt-in to clean node_modules directories and the npm and pnpm caches.
  --dotted       Opt-in to clean inside hidden directories.
  --publish      Opt-in to clean publish directories.
  --artifacts    Opt-in to clean artifacts directories.
  --vs           Opt-in to clean .vs directories (Visual Studio caches).
  --rust         Opt-in to clean Cargo target directories and the CARGO_HOME registry and git caches.
  --nuget        Opt-in to clean NuGet http-cache and global-packages directories.
  --go           Opt-in to clean the Go build cache and module cache.
  --yarn         Opt-in to clean the user-level Yarn cache.
  --pip          Opt-in to clean the pip cache.
  --uv           Opt-in to clean the uv cache.
  --all          Turn on node, dotted, publish, artifacts, vs, rust, nuget, go, yarn, pip, and uv.
